acceptance_criteria.text: A compile-time or Dialyzer-checkable mechanism catches a role_grants atom not present in permissions
acceptance_criteria.evidence: §1.1 selects defmanifest/1 macro as the compile-time mechanism. §1.4 specifies the expansion-time validation loop unambiguously (3-step: extract permissions, extract role_grants, for each perm in each role_grants value assert perm in permissions, else raise CompileError). §1.5 specifies the exact CompileError message format with a concrete example. §4 specifies three tests covering negative path (Code.compile_string/1 must raise CompileError), positive path, and callback contract.

§5 explicitly states validate/1 and validate/2 are not modified, lists all six private validation helpers as unchanged in a table. §3 confirms catalog.ex has No change. §1.3 and §1.6 reinforce that defmanifest is additive opt-in sugar that coexists with runtime validation.

no_implementation_code.notes: All code blocks are fenced as text pseudocode or test-fixture strings for Code.compile_string/1. The macro signature defmacro defmanifest(fields) :: Macro.t() (§3) is a signature only — no body. The expansion description def manifest() :: Letflow.Modules.Module.manifest() is a description, not a body. No def/defp/defmacro function bodies are present.

compile_time_loop_unambiguous.notes: §1.4 provides a 3-step algorithm with no TBD language. Iterates role_grants pairs, inner-iterates perms, checks membership in permissions. __CALLER__.module identified as source of CallerModule in error message. Implementable without guessing.

compile_error_message_specified.notes: §1.5 gives exact template 'role_grants atom :<ATOM> is not declared in permissions for module Elixir.<CallerModule>' plus a concrete instantiated example. No ambiguity in message shape.

ac2_validate_explicitly_covered.notes: §5 is entirely devoted to AC2. Six-row table lists every validation helper as unchanged. Coexistence of compile-time and runtime enforcement points is described clearly.

open_questions_blocking_implementation.notes: §6 declares all decisions resolved with rationale. The @impl true interaction with defmanifest is correctly scoped as an implementation detail (not mandated) and does not block ELIXIR-DEV. Non-literal manifest pass-through policy (§1.3/§2) is resolved. Error message wording is fixed. Fixture as demonstration site is fixed.

tbd_or_deferral_language.notes: No TBD, TODO, deferred, or open-ended deferral language found in the design artefact.

cross_module_dependencies_listed.notes: §3 lists all affected files with precise change descriptions: module.ex (defmacro addition), test/support/modules/fixture/fixture.ex (defmanifest substitution), catalog.ex (no change), catalog_test.exs (no change to existing tests). Dependencies on __CALLER__, CompileError (Elixir built-in), and Letflow.Modules.Module.manifest() type are identified.

routing.notes: Design is complete and unambiguous. Implement defmacro defmanifest/1 in lib/letflow/modules/module.ex, update test/support/modules/fixture/fixture.ex, and add tests per §4.
